title: 定义 1.6

source.quote: pair of natural transformations µ ∶Id_{C} →G ○F and κ ∶F ○G →Id_{D} are compatible

conclusion: $\mu$ 与 $\kappa$ \textbf{同伦意义下相容}，指 $F\xrightarrow{\id\circ\mu}FGF\xrightarrow{\kappa\circ\id}F$ 同伦于 $\id_{F}$，且 $G\xrightarrow{\mu\circ\id}GFG\xrightarrow{\id\circ\kappa}G$ 同伦于 $\id_{G}$（原文第二条误写 $\id_{F}$，译者注已指出）。
label: L12-1.6
